name: Verse Medical
summary: Verse Medical provides AI-enabled ordering and fulfilment for durable medical equipment. It works with major health systems to reduce the administrative friction, coverage checks and delivery failures associated with DME orders.
overview: Verse Medical is a healthcare-technology company focused on durable medical equipment ordering and fulfilment. Its platform uses AI to validate medical necessity and coverage while fitting into providers' existing workflows.

intelligence.description: Verse Medical is a private company tracked by The Private Ledger in healthcare technology.
company: Verse Medical provides AI-enabled ordering and fulfilment for durable medical equipment, including medical-record validation of necessity and coverage validation. The company is designed to fit into clinical workflows while helping patients receive equipment on time.

Verse says it works with nine of the ten largest health systems by revenue and can fulfil orders across DME categories. Those operating claims are company-reported; no confirmed financing amount or valuation has been publicly substantiated.
intelligence.why_it_matters: Verse targets a large but operationally difficult healthcare workflow where automation can improve both patient experience and payment integrity. Its opportunity depends on clinical integration, reimbursement compliance and fulfilment execution.
